definitions.ask: Should text-labeled Markdown links such as `[docs](url)` also show only their label in the idle agenda?
definitions.why: Matches the request; the lightbulb plan deliberately kept prose links verbatim in the agenda

choices.label: Only single-emoji links collapse; text-labeled links keep their full Markdown and URL
Every well-formed Markdown link shows just its label, link-tinted, like the task pickers
